api_call: gh api -X GET search/repositories -f q='icache coherence emulator' -f per_page=10

items.description: MESI snooping coherence protocol implemented on a Harvard Architecture cache system (ICache + DCache), with a UVM-lite SystemVerilog verification suite featuring constrained-random stimulus, bus monitor, scoreboard, and functional coverage. Built on top of the MyPC 80186 FPGA emulator by Waldo Alvarez.
